postureEvents.notes: Low Mass: stand as the celebrant enters.
Low-Mass default profile: kneel for the opening prayers after the altar salute; local/community alternatives remain configurable.
Low Mass source-matrix lock: stand for the Kyrie; this standing posture persists through the Gloria (when appointed) and Collect until the Epistle.
No additional transition required at the Gloria in Low Mass because the STAND state begins at the Kyrie and persists.
Disabled: no sedilia branch at Low Mass.
No additional transition required at the Collect in Low Mass because the STAND state from the Kyrie persists through the Collect.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: sit for Epistle and Gradual/interlection texts.
Low Mass: stand for the Gospel.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: stand for the Credo; genuflection at the Incarnatus is handled as a gesture.
Disabled: no sedilia branch at Low Mass.
Low Mass transitions to sitting after the Gospel/Credo; standing at Orate fratres is handled separately.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: sit for the Offertory after Oremus.
Disabled: no Low-Mass people-incensation branch.
Disabled: no Low-Mass people-incensation branch.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: stand when directly addressed at Orate fratres.
Low Mass: stand for the Preface dialogue and Preface.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: kneel after the Sanctus as the Canon begins.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: normally stand after the Consecration; local/traditional profile may remain kneeling.
Low Mass: stand for the Pater noster.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: after the Agnus Dei kneel for Communion preparation.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: noncommunicants may sit during the ablutions until the Postcommunion greeting.
Low Mass: stand for Dominus vobiscum and the Postcommunion.
Low Mass: kneel for the final blessing.
Low Mass: stand for the Last Gospel; genuflect at Et Verbum via gesture cue.
Low Mass: sit for the sermon/homily; the next active liturgical posture cue resumes the Mass.
Low-Mass O’Connell profile: stand for the direct Orate fratres address; after Suscipiat, return to the Offertory sitting posture for the Secret until the Preface dialogue.

ministerEvents.label: INCENSE
ministerEvents.action: Thurifer presents incense; deacon assists the celebrant at the imposition and blessing.

ministerEvents.label: ALTAR INCENSATION
ministerEvents.action: Deacon and thurifer assist the celebrant during the initial altar incensation.

ministerEvents.label: EPISTLE
ministerEvents.action: Subdeacon chants the Epistle at the appointed place.

ministerEvents.label: EPISTLE COMPLETE
ministerEvents.action: Subdeacon returns after the Epistle for the celebrant’s blessing.

ministerEvents.label: GOSPEL PREPARATION
ministerEvents.action: Deacon prepares for the Gospel and prays Munda cor meum.

ministerEvents.label: BLESSING
ministerEvents.action: Deacon receives the celebrant’s blessing before the Gospel procession.

ministerEvents.label: GOSPEL PROCESSION
ministerEvents.action: Sacred ministers form the Gospel procession.

ministerEvents.label: PUBLIC GOSPEL
ministerEvents.action: Deacon proclaims the public Gospel; the celebrant does not duplicate it.

ministerEvents.label: OFFERTORY INCENSATION
ministerEvents.action: Sacred ministers assist the celebrant through the Offertory incensation.

ministerEvents.label: HOST ELEVATION
ministerEvents.action: Deacon raises the chasuble; subdeacon and torchbearers kneel for the elevation.

ministerEvents.label: CHALICE ELEVATION
ministerEvents.action: Deacon raises the chasuble; subdeacon and torchbearers remain kneeling for the elevation.

ministerEvents.label: PATEN HANDOFF
ministerEvents.action: Subdeacon hands the paten to the deacon, who presents it to the celebrant.

ministerEvents.label: SOLEMN PAX
ministerEvents.action: After the peace prayer, the celebrant gives the Pax to the deacon; it passes to the subdeacon and clergy.

ministerEvents.label: COMMUNION
ministerEvents.action: Deacon assists the celebrant and holds the Communion paten; sacred ministers communicate in Solemn order.

ministerEvents.label: ABLUTIONS
ministerEvents.action: Subdeacon ministers wine and water and reassembles the chalice; deacon transfers the Missal.

ministerEvents.label: DISMISSAL
ministerEvents.action: Deacon sings the dismissal in Solemn Mass.

ministerEvents.label: LAST GOSPEL RESPONSE
ministerEvents.action: Subdeacon gives the prescribed response while the celebrant reads the Last Gospel quietly.

ministerEvents.label: LAST GOSPEL RESPONSE
ministerEvents.action: Subdeacon gives Deo gratias at the conclusion of the Last Gospel.
